topics.title: HS3 Database Transactions
topics.subject: Databases
topics.summary: Atomicity means that a transaction completes entirely or has no effect. Consistency preserves database rules before and after a transaction. Isolation prevents concurrent transactions from interfering with one another. Durability means committed changes survive a restart.

topic.title: HS3 Database Transactions
topic.subject: Databases
topic.content:
Atomicity means that a transaction completes entirely or has no effect.

Consistency preserves database rules before and after a transaction.

Isolation prevents concurrent transactions from interfering with one another.

Durability means committed changes survive a restart.
